result.summary: Found 1 critical issue: text encoding/rendering error in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar delivery time information.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery time text displays as '25-35Ωdelivery' where 'min' appears to be rendered as the Greek letter Omega (Ω), and there is missing spacing between the time and word 'delivery'. This makes the delivery time information unreadable and inaccessible to users.
issues.suggestion: Fix the character encoding or font rendering issue to properly display '25-35 min delivery' with correct spacing between elements. Check for UTF-8 encoding problems or incorrect character substitution in the data or styling.
